title: GRIFFO

body:
# GRIFFO — Modpack for DIOSESMC
### Created by Zeddrik_

GRIFFO is an independent, community-made modpack for **DIOSESMC** players. Born as an optimized alternative to the official modpack, focused on performance, stability, and quality of life — without sacrificing visual experience.

---

## ⚡ Optimization & Performance
Sodium, Lithium, Krypton, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore, C2ME, Noisium, ModernFix, EntityCulling, VMP, and more ensure smooth, stable performance regardless of your hardware.

---

## 🎨 Visuals & Shaders
Full shader support with Iris and Euphoria Patcher, connected textures with Continuity, detailed mobs with Entity Model/Texture Features, physics-based capes with WaveyCapes, and visual effects with Visuality and Smart Particles.

---

## 🖥️ Interface & HUD
Custom menus with FancyMenu and Drippy Loading Screen, inventory HUD, Jade, Shulker Box Tooltip, and JourneyMap for a clean and immersive experience.

---

## 🛠️ Quality of Life
Inventory Profiles Next, Litematica, Bobby, Axiom, and dozens of tweaks so you can focus on enjoying the server.

---

## 🌟 Social & Cosmetics
Essential for skins, emotes, and cosmetics, alongside Chat Heads, Ixeris, and CWB to personalize your presence on the server.

---

## 🛡️ Stability & Bug Fixes
Debugify, CrashExploitFixer, Threaden GL, and Chat Signing Hider for a crash-free experience without annoying bugs.

---

## 🔱 GRIFFO Complementos *(exclusive mod)*
A custom patch created by **Zeddrik_** that fixes Essential's emote animations, ensuring smooth, glitch-free playback.

> ⚠️ GRIFFO Complementos is the exclusive work of Zeddrik_. Redistribution, modification, or use outside this modpack without the author's express authorization is not permitted.

---

## 🎨 Main Menu Design *(exclusive creation)*
The main menu design (FancyMenu), including layouts, buttons, and visual elements, is the exclusive work of **Zeddrik_**, built from scratch.

> ⚠️ Copying, redistributing, or using it without the author's express authorization is not permitted.

---

## ⚙️ Recommended JVM Arguments
```
-Xms6G -Xmx8G -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=40 -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=16M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -Dorg.lwjgl.opengl.Display.allowSoftwareOpenGL=true
```

💾 **Recommended RAM:** Allocate **7168 MB (7GB)** in your launcher for optimal performance.

---

## 📜 Credits
All mods are the property of their respective authors. GRIFFO is a free, non-profit curation.

---

*⚡ GRIFFO — Optimized for DIOSESMC. | Created by Zeddrik_*
